description: The unsigned transaction for one of a ladder's exits, or for a limit order's rule. collect: pays the fees earned and leaves the ladder working. close_part: takes sharePct of every rung out, the rest keeps working. close: pays the fees and returns everything; it is also how a limit order is cancelled (a ladder opened before 30 September 2026 pays a share of a gain: the answer's gainCut). take_nfts: hands the Uniswap position NFTs to the owner; it always works, even when new ladders are paused. close and close_part are simulated first and carry minimums from slippagePct. close_once_filled: for a limit order, sets (on, the default) or clears the rule that has the keeper close it once the price has passed all the way through it and pay what it holds as it is; refused on an order that is filled already (close it), and it adds a deposit to the owner's gas tank when that does not cover one close. On the current LoomLadder: give hands the ladder to another wallet as it is (`to`); delegate lets a wallet run it (`who`, `perms`): a delegate collects, closes or sets rules by naming itself as `actor`, and every payout still goes to the owner.

actor.description: The wallet that will send it, when it is the ladder's delegate and not its owner: it must hold the permission, and the proceeds go to the owner

contract.description: The LoomLadder the ladder lives in, from my_ladders; the current one when left out

on.description: close_once_filled only: false clears the rule

perms.description: delegate: the permissions summed: 1 add, 2 remove (close, close part, take the NFTs, all to the owner), 4 collect (to the owner), 8 rules (autopilot, compounding); 0 ends the delegation

to.description: Where the proceeds go; the owner when left out. give: the wallet that gets the ladder

who.description: delegate: the wallet that may run the ladder

name: plan_ladder_action
title: Collect, partly withdraw, close or take out a ladder
